name: SubmitAITools

sources.title: Submit AI Tools homepage — 'List Your Tool Free', category directory
Submit page — gated by color-click human verification
Promote page — also gated by the same verification

requirements: AI tool product only — the directory is organized purely around AI-tool categories (Productivity, Education, Marketing, Code & IT, Image, Video, Voice, Github Repos, etc.)
Must pass a client-side 'human verification' color-click challenge before the submit form renders
A Login link exists — an account may be required at the actual form (unverified)
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category, logo
Be ready for an interactive verification step that needs rendered-DOM clicking (headless fetches only see the challenge)
workflow: Complete the human-verification challenge — e.g. 'Click the button with the red color' (color varies per load)
Tool appears in its category and the Recent tools list once accepted
watchFor: The color-click gate guards BOTH the submit and promote pages — the actual form fields were not visible to automated reading
Homepage shows paid 'Featured/Ad' slots and a Promote page — free listing exists alongside paid placement, but promote pricing is behind the same verification
Verification answers are interpreted literally — pick the exact named color
countsAsLive: The tool has a detail card/page on submitaitools.org listed under its category and/or the 'Recent AI Tools' feed.
unknowns: Submit-form fields, account requirement, and review latency — all behind the verification wall
